turns.assessment: The outage is isolated to lightpath och134, which is common to all affected working paths. At onset, trx.och134.a at S15 raised an explicit critical EQPT_CARD_FAIL while the far-end interface at S08 reported OCH_LOS; the simultaneous loss of monitoring and traffic at both ends matches the documented CARD_FAIL behavior. Unaffected services on the same node-to-node routes but different lightpaths argue against fibre, amplifier, ROADM, or client-port faults.

proposals.rationale: The S15 interface raised EQPT_CARD_FAIL exactly when all services carried over och134 failed or switched protection. The far end reported OCH_LOS, and och134 receiver measurements became unavailable, matching a failed card that loses its transmitted channel and local receive traffic.
A failed S15 transmitter could produce the far-end OCH_LOS, but it does not adequately explain the explicit card-failure alarm and loss of the S15 unit's receive-side monitoring and traffic.
